page.notes: Hebrew line within the text (Talmudic gloss, printed as a centred line) is transcribed as printed. The right-hand facing page is cut off at the scan edge and largely illegible; its fragments are not transcribed. Marginal notes on the right side of the main block are only fragmentary and could not be read reliably, so they are omitted. The line "Nondum matura est, nolo acerbam sumere" is partly obscured by a handwritten-looking stamp; the final words are uncertain. "Altera" at the foot right appears to be a catchword and is uncertain.
